body:
GREG, verbatim via Engram::Asistant #1733 (TermAl mailbox 588693a8, 2026-11-14 22:33Z): „Windows B jest wylaczony, chyba ze bardzo potrzebuja. sa problemy z pamiecia, nie jest wiarygodny”. Earlier (#1730): „Windows B nie ruszam, ze wzgledu na problemy z pamiecia”.

RULE:
- Do not assume Windows B (host 932a546b) is available or reliable.
- Plan all tests, gates, installs and restarts on Central, DL560 and Mac only.
- Never ask Greg to restart or upgrade Windows B unless there is a concrete case that truly needs it AND has no alternative. Present that case to him with its cause.
- Windows B still appears as an authenticated federation peer running an old build: HEAD be3b6fd8, built 11-11. Treat it as out of scope, not as a host whose build must match.

Applied:
- the baa6 joint restart is Central, DL560 and Mac;
- Engram B5's precondition is scoped to hosts that get B5's Engram build (host-local hazard, Engram::Fable #7965 plus TermAl's caller at acceptance_named_root_sighting.rs:508-515).
